description: The pie chart represents the Token Routing Distribution in FedHLM, showing the proportion of tokens routed to different categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, labeled "LOCAL" and colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. The second slice, labeled "LLM" and colored red, accounts for around 3.9%. The smallest slice, labeled "EDGE_P2P" and colored blue, represents about 1.6%. The percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are ordered in descending size, with the largest slice ("LOCAL") being the most prominent. No legend is present in the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
